items.title: Design and validation of a GMP-compliant manufacturing platform of extracellular vesicles from mesenchymal stromal cells
items.finding: A GMP-compliant, semi-automated mid-scale workflow (single-use stirred-tank expansion of Wharton's jelly MSCs, tangential flow filtration, automated size-exclusion chromatography, in-line CPP monitoring) produced MSC-EVs that met pre-specified CQAs, with CQAs including CD73-associated immunomodulatory activity holding for 12 months at -80C in PlasmaLyte 148.

items.title: Peptide sequence and backbone conjugation chemistry direct alginate hydrogel bioactivity for human mesenchymal stem cell expansion
items.finding: On calcium-crosslinked alginate films, GGFTRGD or CGFTRGD peptides failed to support hMSC expansion, while adding a C-terminal SP (GGFTRGDSP or CGFTRGDSP, closer to native fibronectin) gave robust attachment and a more than 10-fold increase in final cell number; NMR confirmed DMTMM coupling ran through the peptide N-terminus.

items.title: Ion-enriched solution improves the adhesion of freshly thawed umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells and supports cartilage repair in a rat full-thickness cartilage defect model
items.finding: Freshly thawed UC-MSCs had lower proliferation, metabolic activity and adhesion than culture-recovered cells; an ion-enriched carrier (MgCl2 the main contributor, sodium acetate possibly) raised their adhesion in vitro and on OA cartilage ex vivo, and in rats gave 8-week cartilage repair comparable to culture-recovered UC-MSCs in saline.

items.title: Cell cryoisolation and cryopreservation without any organic solvent
items.finding: Aptamer-targeted DNA nanohydrogels delivering trehalose into cells within 2 h gave post-thaw viability comparable to DMSO with 67% fewer differentially expressed genes, extended to MSCs, and used differential freeze-thaw survival to isolate target cells label-free at more than 95% purity.

items.title: Quantifying punctate morphology in mesenchymal stem cells from single cell images provides a definitive quality assessment pipeline for direct correlation to osteogenic lineage differentiation
items.finding: The authors extend an image-based single-cell pipeline (MSCProfiler) to combine bright-field shape features with SA-beta-gal punctate staining across early, mid and late passages of dental pulp MSCs, and relate puncta morphology to osteogenic differentiation capacity.

items.title: A circRNA platform for safe partial reprogramming and rejuvenation of mesenchymal stem cells without pluripotent conversion
items.finding: LNP-delivered circRNA co-expressing OCT4, SOX2 and KLF4 (circ-OSK) rejuvenated late-passage MSCs (lower SA-beta-gal, DNA damage and inflammatory cytokines; proliferation, migration and tri-lineage capacity restored to early-passage levels) without pluripotent conversion by ESRG ddPCR, with MSC markers and genome stability preserved by RNA-seq and SNP array.

items.title: Osteogenic culture of human adipose stem cells on electrospun multispiral poly(e-caprolactone)/beta-tricalcium phosphate composite scaffold in a perfusion bioreactor
items.finding: Over 28 days, hASCs on multispiral PCL/beta-TCP scaffolds in a perfusion bioreactor (4.375 mL/min per channel) produced significantly more mineralized matrix and better mechanical performance than static culture, with robust viability in both.

items.title: Pulsed focused ultrasound-mediated mechanopriming enhances the therapeutic efficacy of mesenchymal stromal cell-derived extracellular vesicles in acute respiratory distress syndrome
items.finding: A single 1-minute pulsed focused ultrasound exposure of UC-MSCs raised EV concentration 1.9-fold without changing size, via calcium-dependent ESCRT upregulation (blocked by EGTA); primed EVs carried more mitochondrial OXPHOS proteins and, in juvenile LPS-ARDS, beat unprimed EVs on barrier integrity, BAL protein, cytokines, neutrophils and histology, with lower serum IgG binding.

items.title: Increased EV yield and bioactivity of matrix-bound nanovesicles compared to conditioned culture medium-derived extracellular vesicles
items.finding: From the same MSC cultures, matrix-bound nanovesicles out-yielded medium EVs 15.6-fold by ultracentrifugation and 7.49-fold by SEC, SEC beat UC for both, day 24 gave the most MBVs, and in a fibroblast scratch assay medium EVs slowed wound closure versus control while MBVs did not.

items.title: Protective effects of PD-L1-overexpressing MSCs and their derived extracellular vesicles in type 1 diabetes
items.finding: PD-L1-overexpressing MSCs and their EVs both suppressed T-cell activity, expanded regulatory T cells, delayed diabetes onset and reduced islet immune infiltration.

items.title: HucMSC-EVs attenuate renal fibrosis via miR-874-3p-mediated inhibition of cGAS-STING signaling
items.finding: Umbilical cord MSC-EVs reduced EMT and fibrosis in cisplatin-injured HK-2 cells and UUO kidneys by lowering mitochondrial ROS and mPTP opening and suppressing cGAS-STING (confirmed with STING inhibitor C-176), with miR-874-3p overexpression partly reproducing the effect.

items.title: Age-associated remodeling of NK cell subsets, B cell subsets, and T cell surface markers in peripheral blood of healthy Chinese adults: a prospective multicolor flow cytometry study
items.finding: In 103 healthy adults aged 20 to 82, total NK frequency rose with age (r = +0.259) while CD56hi CD16- regulatory NK cells fell (r = -0.263) and NK PD-1 rose (r = +0.256); CD8 TEMRA accumulation, CD28 loss and naive depletion were the strongest signals in a second panel of 43.

items.title: Donor-derived unlicensed NK cells promote the hematopoietic engraftment and survival after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
items.finding: In 976 haploidentical HSCT patients after myeloablative conditioning (with a propensity-matched validation), donor-derived unlicensed NK cells independently predicted faster engraftment, lower treatment-related mortality and better overall survival regardless of recipient HLA; U-NK cells boosted HSPC colony formation in vitro and infused U-NK cells sped neutrophil and platelet engraftment in vivo.

items.title: A DNA-scaffolded natural killer cell with adaptable multimodules for enhanced immunotherapy and early efficiency reporting
items.finding: NK cells wrapped in a DNA scaffold carrying oxygen-generating enzymes, GSH-released IL-21 nanoparticles and a granzyme B-activated NIR probe showed better tumor infiltration and in vivo efficacy, with a fluorescence response readout as early as 6 h after infusion.

items.title: Decreased NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity is associated with hypoalbuminemia in hemodialysis patients
items.finding: In 30 hemodialysis patients versus 30 controls, NK cells showed subset and receptor changes distinct from normal aging (mapped in 44 healthy people) and reduced cytotoxicity, and patients with higher NK cytotoxicity had significantly higher albumin.

items.title: NK cell immune fitness stratifies small cell lung cancer into four functional states associated with clinical response
items.finding: In SCLC patients profiled before and after cisplatin, responders had strong interferon signaling and CD16+ cytotoxic NK1 enrichment linked to longer progression-free survival, non-responders were NK3-quiescent, CD16 but not CD56 predicted survival in tumor infiltrates, and an NK fitness signature defined four immune states.

items.title: Aged microenvironment-triggered nanoreactors rejuvenate senescent LepR+ cells to remodel aged bone marrow
items.finding: Senescent LepR+ marrow stromal cells sustain a loop of low NO, low Mg2+ and rising ROS; a senescent-cell-membrane-coated nanoreactor releasing NO and Mg2+ while scavenging ROS targeted LepR+ cells, reduced senescence phenotypes and improved aged marrow regeneration, with RNA-seq supporting loop disruption.

items.title: Pharmacological depletion of macrophages leads to a reduction in inflammation and senescence in aged murine kidneys
items.finding: In aged mice, low-dose CSF1R inhibitor PLX5622 partly reduced kidney macrophages and significantly lowered IL-6, TNF-alpha, CX3CR1, p16 and SA-beta-gal without raising blood urea nitrogen, whereas high-dose depletion raised BUN.

items.title: CD38 drives cellular senescence and ischemia-reperfusion injury in donor lungs
items.finding: CD38 in human donor lungs rose with donor age and ischemic stress, especially in DCD grafts, tracking SASP signaling; in mouse lung IRI, CD38 deletion or inhibition preserved NAD+, cut SASP mediators and injury and improved mechanics, and CD38 knockdown in HUVECs blunted oxidative-stress senescence.
